title: Concurrent provisionTenantSchema races on stale search_path → C42P01 "relation X does not exist" (post-GBL-112)
notes: Discovered while implementing the regression test for ISS-0129 (C40P01 deadlock fix). After GBL-112 dropped public.users/public.user_roles, migration 008's CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users races against a pool connection whose search_path is stale. Tests RT-1 / RT-2 in tests/integration/iss0129_migration_run_advisory_lock_test.zig intermittently fail with C42P01 'relation users does not exist' / 'relation user_roles does not exist' during the FIRST concurrent pass, even though the underlying lock fix (Migrations.runForSchema pg_advisory_xact_lock) is verified correct by 172-test integration suite run with zero C40P01 deadlocks. The lock serializes concurrent migrate steps correctly; the C42P01 is a separate pool-state race. Out of scope for ISS-0129 — the original deadlock is fixed.
root_cause: Pool connection reused after a prior transaction commits. The tenant schema's search_path was set via SET search_path TO <schema>, public (session-level), but when a SECOND pool.acquire() returns a connection that last served a public-schema migration (search_path=public), the unqualified CREATE TABLE users lands in public — which doesn't exist for new tenants after GBL-112 dropped it. Migration 008 then fails because migration 040 references users/user_roles BEFORE its CREATE TABLE. Fix options: (a) schema-qualify the CREATE TABLE in 008/017/040 (tenant_<uuid>.users), (b) force SET LOCAL search_path inside the migration runner before each simpleQuery call, (c) force pool reset between connections.
repro_steps: 3. RT-1 / RT-2 fail intermittently with C42P01 'relation users does not exist'
candidate_resolution: Schema-qualify the CREATE TABLE statements in migrations 008, 017, and 040 to use the current schema name (e.g. CREATE TABLE tenant_<uuid>.users). Alternatively, force SET LOCAL search_path TO <schema>, public at the start of each per-migration transaction in Migrations.runForSchema. Verify RT-1/RT-2 in iss0129 regression suite pass deterministically.
resolution: Fixed via the systemic runner-level hardening (candidate option b), not migration-file patching: `SET LOCAL search_path TO <schema>,public` is now re-asserted as the first statement immediately after BEGIN inside Migrations.runForSchema's per-migration transaction (src/db/migrations.zig), in addition to the existing session-level SET at function entry. SET LOCAL is strictly transaction-scoped and cannot leak past COMMIT/ROLLBACK, so every migration's DDL/DML now executes under the correct search_path regardless of the pooled connection's prior session-level state. Landed in commit 1d388ba (PR #531, GH #423) on 2026-08-07, which also added a dedicated regression test (ISS-0130 RT-6 in tests/integration/iss0129_migration_run_advisory_lock_test.zig) exercising the exact sequential-reprovisioning-after-concurrent-pass scenario the original RT-1/RT-2 comments called out as untested, plus an RT-5 source-stability assertion for the SET LOCAL string. Independently verified in run WF03-ISS-0130-20260807 (docs/issue-reports/ISS-0130-diagnosis.yaml): could not empirically reproduce the original C42P01 after 40 repro attempts pre-fix (likely narrowed by the concurrently-merged ISS-0131/GH #424 provisionTenantSchema session-lock fix), and confirmed 0 regressions post-fix via `zig build test` producing byte-identical results (918/1003 passing, 21 pre-existing unrelated failures -- see ISS-0209) on both the feature branch and a clean origin/main worktree. This ISS file's status/resolved_at were left stale (OPEN/null) by the resolving run despite handoffs/global_queue.json and the GitHub PR both showing RESOLVED/merged; corrected here as bookkeeping cleanup, no code change.
acceptance_criteria: RT-1 and RT-2 in tests/integration/iss0129_migration_run_advisory_lock_test.zig pass deterministically (5/5 stable)
Existing integration test suite still passes
prevention: After GBL-112 dropped public.users/user_roles, all per-tenant migration DDL that touches these tables MUST be schema-qualified OR the migration runner MUST SET LOCAL search_path at the start of each per-migration transaction.
Add a regression test that runs N concurrent provisionTenantSchema calls back-to-back and verifies deterministic completion within timeout.
